استوعبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْعَبُوا (istawʕabū) /is.taw.ʕa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَوْعَبَ (istawʕaba)
# اُسْتُوعِبُوا (ustūʕibū) /us.tuː.ʕi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْعَبَ (istawʕaba)
# اِسْتَوْعِبُوا (istawʕibū) /is.taw.ʕi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْعَبَ (istawʕaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
